title: Create: Advancement Rewards
description: Adds rewards to the create-mod advancements, designed for economy based servers
body:
**Requires Version 6 of Create _and_ Numismatics 1.0.14**

This datapack modifies all of the advancements added by the Create mod so that when you complete the advancement it rewards you with a few coins from the numismatics mod. 

It is designed with SMP server economies in mind, to make coins a resource that can be earned by simply playing the game and completing advancements, instead of grinding for repeatable missions. As there is a limited number of advancements that a player can achieve, this then limits the amount of money in the servers economy to help avoid inflation. 

### Rewards
- Basic advancements with a simple square border will reward the player with 4 spurs upon completion.

![Basic advancements grant 4 spurs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f633254f07928afbd2f1ae77dfbae13f0da03a8.png)
- Goals with the curved border will reward the player with 1 bevel (8 spurs) upon completion.

![Goals grant 1 bevel (8 spurs)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd652f21a633e6b6a6e2bd8daacd6102cf3f6efa.png)
- Hidden advancements will grant 1 sprocket (16 spurs) as a reward.

![hidden achievements award 1 sprocket (16 spurs)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18c74ce78d0af5e8948948cedb0172f6647dcfbd.png)


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

_information tidbit_ - if a player manages to complete all advancements, then they would have earned a total of 10 cogs and 52 spurs

</details>
